steps.name: environment
steps.description: Set up core development environment. If ENABLE_ANDROID_SDK=1 is set in the environment, install and configure a minimal Android command-line SDK: ensure OpenJDK >=17, download cmdline-tools and normalize them to $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest, write /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh with ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/ANDROID_HOME/JAVA_HOME and PATH exports, chown SDK directories to the invoking non-root user, non-interactively accept SDK licenses and install platform-tools, platforms;android-33 and build-tools;33.0.2. If ENABLE_ANDROID_SDK is unset or 0, skip Android installs to avoid interactive sdkmanager prompts. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
ENABLE_ANDROID_SDK="${ENABLE_ANDROID_SDK:-0}"
ANDROID_SDK_ROOT_DEFAULT="${HOME}/android-sdk"
CMDLINE_URL_DEFAULT="https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-9477386_latest.zip"
COMMANDLINE_TOOLS_URL="${COMMANDLINE_TOOLS_URL:-$CMDLINE_URL_DEFAULT}"
GRADLE_CLI_VERSION="8.4.1"
EXEC_USER=${SUDO_USER:-$(id -un)}
EXEC_UID=${SUDO_UID:-$(id -u)}
EXEC_GID=${SUDO_GID:-$(id -g)}
# base tools
sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unzip ca-certificates curl >/dev/null
# Java check/install
JAVA_MAJOR=0
if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then ver=$(java -version 2>&1 | awk -F '"' '/version/ {print $2; exit}' || true); fi
if [ -n "${ver:-}" ]; then major=$(printf '%s\n' "$ver" | cut -d. -f1); JAVA_MAJOR=${major%%[^0-9]*}; fi
if [ -z "$JAVA_MAJOR" ] || [ "$JAVA_MAJOR" -lt 17 ]; then sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-17-jdk >/dev/null; fi
JAVA_BIN=$(command -v java || true)
if [ -n "$JAVA_BIN" ]; then JAVA_HOME_RESOLVED=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$JAVA_BIN" || echo "$JAVA_BIN")")"); else JAVA_HOME_RESOLVED=""; fi
# Android SDK opt-in
ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT_DEFAULT}"
if [ "$ENABLE_ANDROID_SDK" = "1" ]; then
  sudo mkdir -p "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" && sudo chown -R ${EXEC_UID}:${EXEC_GID} "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
  SDKTOOLS_DEST="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"
  if [ ! -x "$SDKTOOLS_DEST/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then
    tmpd=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$tmpd"
    curl -sSfL "$COMMANDLINE_TOOLS_URL" -o cmdline.zip
    unzip -q cmdline.zip || (echo "ERROR: unzip cmdline-tools" >&2; exit 3)
    sdkmgr_path=$(find . -type f -name sdkmanager -print -quit || true)
    if [ -n "$sdkmgr_path" ]; then sdkmgr_dir=$(dirname "$sdkmgr_path"); parent_dir=$(dirname "$sdkmgr_dir"); sudo rm -rf "$SDKTOOLS_DEST" && sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "$SDKTOOLS_DEST")" && sudo mv "$parent_dir" "$SDKTOOLS_DEST" 2>/dev/null || sudo mv "$sdkmgr_dir" "$SDKTOOLS_DEST"; else if [ -d cmdline-tools ]; then sudo rm -rf "$SDKTOOLS_DEST" && sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "$SDKTOOLS_DEST")" && sudo mv cmdline-tools "$SDKTOOLS_DEST"; fi; fi
    cd /tmp && rm -rf "$tmpd"
    sudo chown -R ${EXEC_UID}:${EXEC_GID} "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
  fi
  # atomic profile.d write
  PROFILE_TMP=$(mktemp)
  cat > "$PROFILE_TMP" <<EOF
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}"
export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}"
EOF
  if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME_RESOLVED" ]; then cat >> "$PROFILE_TMP" <<EOF
export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME_RESOLVED}"
EOF
  fi
  cat >> "$PROFILE_TMP" <<'EOF'
export PATH="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}/platform-tools:${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}/build-tools:${PATH}"
EOF
  sudo mv "$PROFILE_TMP" /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh && sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh
  # source for current shell
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh || true
  SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
  if [ -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
    "$SDKMANAGER" --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: sdkmanager exists but failed to run" >&2; exit 4; }
    # accept licenses non-interactively
    yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --sdk_root="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" --licenses >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: sdkmanager --licenses failed" >&2; exit 5; }
    "$SDKMANAGER" --sdk_root="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" --install "platform-tools" "platforms;android-33" "build-tools;33.0.2" >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: sdkmanager install failed" >&2; exit 6; }
  else
    echo "ERROR: sdkmanager not found at $SDKMANAGER" >&2; exit 7
  fi
else
  # do not touch Android SDK when not enabled; leave a safe stub to avoid undefined env references
  if [ ! -f /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh ]; then
    PROFILE_TMP=$(mktemp)
    echo "export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=\"\"" > "$PROFILE_TMP"
    echo "export ANDROID_HOME=\"\"" >> "$PROFILE_TMP"
    sudo mv "$PROFILE_TMP" /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh && sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh || true
  fi
fi
# keystore placeholder (workspace-owned)
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/android/keystore"
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/android/keystore/debug.keystore" ]; then
  keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$WORKSPACE/android/keystore/debug.keystore" -storepass android -keypass android -alias debug -dname "CN=debug" -keyalg RSA -validity 365 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sudo chown -R ${EXEC_UID}:${EXEC_GID} "$WORKSPACE/android/keystore" || true
fi
# Gradle fallback (only install when gradlew missing and gradle absent)
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/gradlew" ] && ! command -v gradle >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  GRADLE_DIR="/opt/gradle/gradle-${GRADLE_CLI_VERSION}"
  if [ ! -x "$GRADLE_DIR/bin/gradle" ]; then tmpd=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$tmpd" && curl -sSfL "https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-${GRADLE_CLI_VERSION}-bin.zip" -o gradle.zip && sudo mkdir -p /opt/gradle && sudo unzip -q gradle.zip -d /opt/gradle && rm -rf "$tmpd"; fi
  if [ -x "$GRADLE_DIR/bin/gradle" ]; then PROFILE_TMP2=$(mktemp); echo "export PATH=\"/opt/gradle/gradle-${GRADLE_CLI_VERSION}/bin:\${PATH}\"" > "$PROFILE_TMP2"; sudo mv "$PROFILE_TMP2" /etc/profile.d/gradle.sh && sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/gradle.sh; # shellcheck disable=SC1091
    source /etc/profile.d/gradle.sh || true
  fi
fi
# final validation
command -v java >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: java missing" >&2; exit 9; }

#!/usr/bin/env bash

EOF
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/android/build.gradle" <<'EOF'

EOF
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/android/app/build.gradle" <<'EOF'

EOF

#!/usr/bin/env bash

WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "${WORKSPACE}/android" || { echo "SKIPPED: no android dir" > "${WORKSPACE}/.start_status"; exit 0; }
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: do not run build as root" >&2; exit 2; fi

  if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon || { echo "BUILD_FAILED" > "${WORKSPACE}/.start_status"; exit 3; }

fi
EOF

steps.name: dependencies
steps.description: Install project dependencies non-interactively. Enforces non-root execution. Always performs Node (npm ci) and .NET (dotnet restore) installs when detected. Android sdkmanager/license operations are only performed in env-001 when ENABLE_ANDROID_SDK=1 — this script will NOT attempt to accept licenses itself, avoiding interactive blocking during dependency installation. When an Android AGP project is present and gradle/gradlew is required for validation, the script will check for gradlew or system gradle and fail fast with a clear error if missing. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: run dependency installation as non-root user" >&2; exit 2; fi
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: node missing" >&2; exit 3; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: npm missing" >&2; exit 4; }
# Node deps
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --silent; else npm i --silent; fi

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Perform headless validation lifecycle for Android artifacts when a real AGP project is present. BUILD using gradlew/gradle (only if plugin present), START by inspecting produced APK/AAB, STOP by stopping gradle daemons, TEST artifact integrity using apksigner if available (resolved under SDK build-tools) or classes.dex check, and write evidence into .last_build_artifact and .validation_result. If project is placeholder or gradle unavailable, emit SKIPPED. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
OUT_RESULT="$WORKSPACE/.validation_result"
EVIDENCE_FILE="$WORKSPACE/.last_build_artifact"
if [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE/android" ]; then echo -e "STATUS=SKIPPED\nREASON=no android project" > "$OUT_RESULT" && exit 0; fi
cd "$WORKSPACE/android"
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: do not run validation build as root" >&2; exit 2; fi
if ! grep -qE "com.android.application|com.android.library|id\(['\"]com.android.application|id\(['\"]com.android.library" -R app 2>/dev/null; then echo -e "STATUS=SKIPPED\nREASON=placeholder android scaffold (no AGP plugin)" > "$OUT_RESULT" && exit 0; fi
if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then CMD=(./gradlew); elif command -v gradle >/dev/null 2>&1; then CMD=(gradle); else echo -e "STATUS=SKIPPED\nREASON=no gradle or gradlew available" > "$OUT_RESULT" && exit 0; fi
"${CMD[@]}" assembleDebug --no-daemon || { echo -e "STATUS=FAIL\nREASON=gradle build failed" > "$OUT_RESULT"; exit 3; }
APK=""
for p in app/build/outputs/apk/*/app-*-debug.apk app/build/outputs/bundle/*/*.aab; do for f in $p; do [ -f "$f" ] && { APK="$f"; break 2; } done; done
if [ -z "$APK" ]; then APK=$(find . -type f \( -iname "*.apk" -o -iname "*.aab" \) -print -quit || true); fi
if [ -z "$APK" ]; then echo -e "STATUS=FAIL\nREASON=no apk/aab found" > "$OUT_RESULT"; exit 4; fi
size=$(stat -c%s "$APK" || echo 0)
sha=$(sha256sum "$APK" | awk '{print $1}' || echo "")
mtime=$(stat -c%y "$APK" || echo "")
echo "artifact=$APK" > "$EVIDENCE_FILE"
echo "size=$size" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE"
echo "sha256=$sha" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE"
echo "mtime=$mtime" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE"
APKSIGNER_CMD=$(command -v apksigner || true)
if [ -z "$APKSIGNER_CMD" ] && [ -n "${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -d "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/build-tools" ]; then
  latest_bt=$(ls -1 "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/build-tools" | sort -V | tail -n1 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$latest_bt" ] && [ -x "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/build-tools/$latest_bt/apksigner" ]; then APKSIGNER_CMD="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/build-tools/$latest_bt/apksigner"; fi
fi
if [ -n "$APKSIGNER_CMD" ] && [ -x "$APKSIGNER_CMD" ]; then
  if "$APKSIGNER_CMD" verify --print-certs "$APK" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "APKSIGNER=OK" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE"; else echo "APKSIGNER=FAILED" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE" && echo -e "STATUS=FAIL\nREASON=apksigner verify failed" > "$OUT_RESULT" && exit 5; fi
else
  if unzip -l "$APK" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "classes.dex"; then echo "DEX_PRESENT=YES" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE"; else echo "DEX_PRESENT=NO" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE" && echo -e "STATUS=FAIL\nREASON=classes.dex missing" > "$OUT_RESULT" && exit 6; fi
fi
if unzip -l "$APK" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "AndroidManifest.xml"; then echo "MANIFEST_PRESENT=YES" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE"; else echo "MANIFEST_PRESENT=NO" >> "$EVIDENCE_FILE"; fi
if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew --stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
echo -e "STATUS=PASS\nREASON=artifact built and smoke-checked" > "$OUT_RESULT"
echo "validation complete; evidence in $EVIDENCE_FILE"
